requirement: HTTP/SSE execution of the persisted symbolic AOT profile
implementation: LocalModel selects the native, native-artifact or symbolic-artifact backend. Symbolic artifacts execute the stored programs under their compiled context cap. Per-request KV and UTF-8 buffering remain in the common request path. Ambiguous profile markers fail startup.

verification.transport: TCP HTTP/1.1 JSON and SSE, with dechunked response parsing
verification.fixture: Zero-layer byte-token GGUF, symbolically compiled for 6, 3 and 2 tokens of context; requested prompt has 3 tokens.
assertions: UTF-8 é is identical in JSON and SSE with no prompt echo
full compiled context produces an empty completion without error
prompt exceeding compiled context yields JSON error or one SSE error terminal event
exactly one DONE and exactly one terminal event for each stream
changed stored program and updated hash change HTTP output
moved identical GGUF is accepted through --weights
mixed native and symbolic artifact markers reject startup
verification.server_tests: 7 unit tests and 2 real HTTP integration tests passed, including the existing native artifact path

limitations: This fixture verifies server routing, persistence and output contracts; C64/C65 separately cover nonzero-layer causal arithmetic and AOT parity.
No large-model symbolic numerical-range or performance claim.
The distributed remote-worker path is unchanged.
